sop.purpose: Ingest bordereaux-like carrier feeds and produce distribution performance metrics for agency operations.
steps: Use bordereaux_ingest to normalize CSV or JSON rows into policy, producer, channel, period, premium, and commission fields.
Run distribution_analytics for summary, benchmark, and trend views across GWP, commission ratio, productivity, and retention proxy.
Use attrition_scorer and incentive_targeting when producer productivity or retention signals require follow-up action.
Publish metric assumptions, rejected row counts, benchmark deltas, and recommended workflow next steps.
controls: Flag analytics based on partial or rejected bordereaux rows as preliminary.
Require human review before using incentives to change compensation or producer status.

triggers: Commission ratio, retention proxy, or productivity materially misses benchmark.
Attrition or incentive output conflicts with compliance or compensation controls.
escalation.sla: Two business days for data quality blockers; one weekly business review cycle for benchmark action plans.

remember: Dataset period, source, accepted and rejected counts
retrieve: Prior periods for the same producer, agency, channel, and product line
Active retention and incentive playbook thresholds
redact: Customer identifiers not needed for aggregate analytics
Raw carrier feed fields outside the normalized metric set
Individual compensation details unless needed for commission-ratio analysis
